sources.title: Grapheme-to-Phoneme Models — NeMo-Speech
sources.snippet: G2P-Conformer CTC model - uses a Conformer encoder [g2p-2] followed by a linear decoder; the model is trained with CTC-loss. G2P-Conformer model has about 20 times fewer parameters than the ByT5 model and is a non-autoregressive model that makes it faster during inference.

sources.title: Grapheme-to-Phoneme Models — NVIDIA NeMo Framework User Guide
sources.snippet: G2P-Conformer CTC model - uses a Conformer encoder [g2p-2] followed by a linear decoder; the model is trained with CTC-loss. G2P-Conformer model has about 20 times fewer parameters than the ByT5 model and is a non-autoregressive model that makes it faster during inference. The models can be trained using words or sentences as input.
